ov: Stout-bodied rodents with cheek pouches that stretch to their shoulders, used to carry food home. Of 19 species, the golden or Syrian hamster is the popular pet.

why.ac: Wild hamsters are crepuscular, active at twilight; pet hamsters become nocturnal, waking around sundown.
why.h: Wild Syrian hamsters can hibernate for a few days at a time; pet hamsters don’t.
why.p: The golden or Syrian hamster is the most common pet; dwarf hamsters are kept too.

rg: Wild golden hamsters live only in a dry region of northern Syria and southern Turkey, where their numbers are falling.
df: Mainly seeds, fruit and other plants, plus some insects.
notes: The existing fact (pet golden hamsters descend from one 1930 litter) is confirmed: mitochondrial DNA traces them to one female captured in Aleppo in 1930.
